recommended_policy.content:
# Example only. The installer prints this file and never merges it into your
# policy (packages bring tools, administrators build roles).
# Tool names assume the default namespace "files"; adjust if you renamed it.
version: "2.0.0"
default_deny: true
roles:
  files_user:
    description: "Upload files and get download links for files this user uploaded."
    allow:
      - files_create_upload_url
      - files_get_download_link
      - files_get_file_info
critical_tools:
  - files_create_upload_url
  - files_get_download_link
